benchmarkMethod.startup: Fresh pages on warm production servers, trusted click and jump, fixed seeds 42 and 43. AB, BA, AB desktop order, one matched CPU-compositor control. CPU submit is not scanout.
benchmarkMethod.scene: 24 measured complete renders per fixture with the same fixed camera/weather sequence, separate Chrome CPU compositor. WebGL2 finish denied by the test. Time is JS/Canvas submit, not browser composition.
benchmarkMethod.kernel: 40 changing atmospheric inputs after 12 warm frames per workload and two isolated Node/esbuild runs per build. Exact Float32 RGBA hashes compare sky and mist, with decoded atlas and asset denial.

how deep the blade cuts does not depend on the frame rate
no joint is welded shut in any core strike
six extra authored keys in each sword ritual preserve timing and gate beats
a connecting strike puts the striking joint ON the body, not near it
